events.title: First FORTRAN compiler delivered
events.summary: The first documented commercial FORTRAN compiler shipped to Westinghouse-Bettis for reactor design on the [IBM] 704.
events.about: Same language as the FORTRAN announcement — used by engineers and scientists who needed numeric simulation without hand-writing assembly. Early adopters ran reactor design and other heavy calculation jobs on [IBM] 704-class machines.

narrative.whyChosen: Announcement at a conference is one moment; delivery is when the language became usable in the wild.
narrative.whyImportant: It moved FORTRAN from research demo to production tool for engineering workloads.
narrative.problemSolved: Teams needed a working compiler on real hardware, not just a paper specification.
